name: Australia
prevalence_note: NASC Scamwatch, ATO & ACMA 2025-2026: fake ATO / myGov arrest-warrant & TFN compromise calls, Big Four bank (CommBank, NAB, ANZ, Westpac) NetCode / PayID 'safe account' impersonation, Linkt toll notices, NBN/Telstra remote-access scams, and urgent family new-number scams dominate.
cross_border_note: Offshore scam syndicates routinely spoof +61 Australian mobile and local landline CLI numbers via international VoIP gateways to impersonate banks, the ATO, Telstra, or NBN; under the ACMA Reducing Scam Calls and Scam SMs Industry Code (C661:2022), Australian telcos actively trace and block billions of spoofed international calls and SMS messages.

scams.name: Fake ATO / myGov Arrest Warrant & Holding Account Scam
scams.name_en: Fake Australian Taxation Office or myGov caller threatening arrest over a tax debt or compromised TFN
scams.signals_en: Poses as the ATO or myGov claiming an unpaid tax debt, crypto audit penalty, or compromised Tax File Number (TFN), threatening immediate arrest unless funds are moved to a 'federal holding account' or paid via gift cards or cryptocurrency.
scams.legit_en: The real ATO and myGov never threaten arrest on the phone, never send unsolicited login links, and never ask for gift cards, cryptocurrency, or transfers to a personal or 'holding' account.
bait_tactics: Sound worried and ask which financial year's tax return is affected while pretending to look through a filing cabinet for old notices
Ask the caller to spell their section name slowly and say your myGov passkey is on another device at home

scams.name: Fake Australian Bank Fraud Team (NetCode, PayID & Safe Account)
scams.name_en: Fake CommBank, NAB, ANZ, or Westpac fraud team asking for NetCodes, PayID setup, or safe-account transfers
scams.signals_en: Caller spoofing CommBank, NAB, ANZ, or Westpac fraud departments warns of suspicious transactions and pressures the owner to read out an SMS NetCode or one-time security code, link a new PayID, or transfer savings to a 'safe account'.
scams.legit_en: Genuine Australian banks verify callers via in-app notifications (such as CommBank CallerCheck) and never ask customers to share NetCodes or one-time codes, register an external PayID, or move money to a 'safe account'.
bait_tactics: Say mobile reception in your back room is poor so no SMS code has arrived yet, and ask them to send an in-app verification prompt instead
Slowly ask which merchant and suburb the suspicious card charge came from while pretending to hunt for your reading glasses

scams.name: Fake Linkt Overdue Motorway Toll Scam
scams.name_en: Fake Linkt toll call or follow-up demanding immediate card payment for an overdue toll notice
scams.signals_en: Claims the owner has an overdue Linkt motorway toll balance and faces enforcement fines or account suspension unless paid immediately through an SMS link or by reading card details over the phone.
scams.legit_en: Genuine Australian toll operators issue statements via the official Linkt app or post and never demand urgent credit card details or link clicks over an unexpected call.
bait_tactics: Ask which motorway gantry and date the toll occurred on while pretending to look for your vehicle registration papers
Say your household has two cars and ask them to describe the vehicle make and state plate slowly

scams.name: NBN / Telstra Remote Access Tech & Broadband Scam
scams.name_en: Fake NBN, Telstra, or IT security caller requesting remote access and online banking login
scams.signals_en: Callers pose as NBN Co, Telstra technical support, or cyber-security staff warning that the owner's broadband line or modem has been hacked, instructing them to install screen-sharing tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Zoho) and open online banking.
scams.legit_en: NBN Co never makes unsolicited calls to consumers (as it is a wholesale network provider), and legitimate Australian telcos like Telstra never ask customers to install remote-access software or open online banking during fault checks.
bait_tactics: Say your laptop takes ages to boot after an update and ask which exact light on the NBN connection box is meant to be flashing
Tell them you only have an old flip phone in your hand right now and ask whether they can post a written fault report

scams.name: Urgent Family or 'Hi Mum' New-Number Emergency Scam
scams.name_en: Impersonated family member calling from a new number with an urgent payment request
scams.signals_en: Callers or follow-up voice clone / WhatsApp fraudsters pose as a child or close relative using a 'new number' because their phone was dropped or damaged, pressuring an urgent transfer to a third-party account to cover an invoice or crisis.
scams.legit_en: Real relatives with a damaged phone can confirm private family details and wait while you ring their saved original number directly to double-check.
bait_tactics: Say the phone line sounds muffled, ask which relative is calling without guessing a name, and ask what happened to their usual handset
Say banking is not set up on this phone so you will ring their old number and check with the rest of the family first
